notes: Background: mid-market B2B product analytics vendor. Building an in-app chat + insights assistant + semantic search for user reports.
Went from hosted API trial -> exploring Dedicated because of predictability and unit economics at scale.
POC summary (hosted): 3-week trial (late Jan - mid Feb). Ingested 12M tokens across chat and embeddings. Peak sustained QPS observed: 45 QPS during weekday peak; spike tests hit 120 QPS for 60s.

Performance targets: product team requires p95 latency < 200ms for short-chat (prompt+generate <= 300 tokens), p95 < 500ms for typical flows. Current hosted p95 observed ~380ms for generation path at 45 QPS.
Traffic profile (observed during trial): avg request tokens = 110, avg generated tokens = 220, embedding calls ~18% of requests but small token counts; reranking makes up ~6% of calls.
Token mix estimate for production: 65% generation, 25% embeddings, 10% reranking. Expected avg token length per request ~150 input + 200 output.

Concurrency / QPS forecasting: baseline 30 QPS, expected steady-state 90 QPS in 12 months, planning capacity for 200 QPS peak bursts. Concurrency target for Dedicated: 120 concurrent generation streams to cover 95th percentile spikes.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market buyer. Wants clear per-token and per-concurrency cost breakdown; open to committed monthly reserved commit if unit cost delta >25% vs hosted.
Security/compliance notes: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML must be tested, encryption keys via customer KMS desirable, data residency = US only for initial roll-out.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-12 call: "Predictable latency and lock-step failover between regions are non-negotiable for us. We need a path off hosted that doesn't spike costs."
POC docs: Fireflies transcript, usage CSVs and perf graphs uploaded to shared Drive links above.
Decision process: evaluation committee = CTO, Head of Product, Infra Lead, Procurement. Procurement wants 3 vendor TCOs, product team prioritizes latency and model quality.
Desired rollout: pilot on Dedicated (one pool) for prod beta with 3 teams, then scale to 2 pools across regions after 6 months.
Internal Redwood asks: provide Dedicated sizing recommendation (GPU types, pool count), burst capacity options, expected p95 latency for their token mix, and committed discount tiers.
Notes on fallback/routing: they want automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variant for low-priority requests and strict routing by region & customer tier.
Open legal review items: data residency clause, KMS integration SLA, retention controls for logs and prompts.
POC outcome: product team impressed with quality, wants more deterministic SLOs before committing to Dedicated.
Sales ask: Pricing worksheet + draft SOW to run procurement/finance review by 2026-03-15.
